mentions.name: VADPCM audio encoder/decoder
mentions.description: An audio encoder/decoder for VADPCM, a codec reverse engineered from the Nintendo 64, with recent bug fixes; some people are using it to dub Conker's Bad Fur Day into Spanish.
mentions.source_excerpt: Recently fixed bugs in an audio encoder / decoder (VADPCM) I reverse engineered from the Nintendo 64, and some people are apparently using it to dub Conker’s Bad Fur Day into Spanish.
